BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer & Valuer proudly brings to the market for sale this substantial detached property situated in this quiet residential development in Shanbally village.

This property offers a huge opportunity for someone to acquire a well-appointed home that has a huge amount of living and bedroom accommodation with generous size rooms throughout, consisting of approximately 2,705sq ft. It offers an abundance of space with a nice open plan layout on the ground floor. Upstairs, it has four double bedrooms (2 en-suites) & main family bathroom making it ideal for a growing family.

Outside it has a fully walled in site featuring a spacious rear lawned garden that offers excellent privacy and to the front, has a chipped driveway with plenty on site parking. 

It is most conveniently located, within walking distance to the local national school, shop, pub & church in Shanbally village and just a mere 5/10 minutes drive to Carrigaline. It is just minutes to Ringaskiddy, where a host of major multi-national pharmaceutical companies employers are based along with the Port of Cork & National Maritime College of Ireland. 

Viewing of this ideal family home in a quiet mature residential area comes highly recommended.

c. 251.3 sq metres (2,705 sq ft)
Gas Fired Central Heating
PVC Double Glazed Windows & Doors
Fully walled in garden with excellent privacy
Spacious bedroom and living accommodation
Enclosed rear garden
Small residential development in cul-de-sac position
Minutes walk to local school, shop, pub & church in Shanbally village
Short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy
Regular public bus service available close-by

From Cork heading toward Carrigaline, take your 1st exit at The Shannonpark roundabout, heading for Ringaskiddy. Continue on for approximately 3-4km and you enter into Shanbally village. Just as you enter the village, Ard Na Greine is on the left handside before the The Shamrock Bar. Upon entering the estate, turn an immediate left and the 2nd right turn. No.7 is the first property on the right handside, indicated by our "For Sale" sign. Follow Eircode P43 X025
